meta.source: Sampled from the 'Explore สียางจัดฟัน' LINE poster (pixel-sampled) plus the storefront purples the clinic already uses. Values marked 'derived' are not on the poster.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, speech bubbles, the contact bar. The poster's white panels.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Page / poster ground — the pastel sky blue behind the lower half of the poster.

tokens.name: sky-200
tokens.usage: Deeper sky wash for cloud shapes and section bands on sky-100. Decorative, no text.

tokens.name: lilac-100
tokens.usage: Feature-tile discs that hold a violet icon. violet-500 icons on it pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pink-100
tokens.usage: Pastel pink speech bubbles and handwritten-note bubbles. ink text on it passes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body text — the deep navy of 'ขั้นตอน', 'เพิ่มเพื่อนใน LINE' and the feature captions. 15:1 on surface, 12:1 on sky-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Derived (navy at lower strength). Sub-captions and secondary lines. 7:1 on surface, 5.8:1 on sky-100.

tokens.name: pink-500
tokens.usage: Primary brand pink — the 'เลือกสีที่ใช่' CTA, step-2 badge, the 'Explore' pill and hearts. White text on it is 3.1:1: only for text 24px+ bold (as on the poster).

tokens.name: pink-400
tokens.usage: Lighter pink for big numerals ('2') and the top of pink gradients. Decorative / display only.

tokens.name: pink-600
tokens.usage: Derived. Pink fill when it carries text under 24px (white 4.7:1), and pink text on white.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Step-1 badge fill and soft blue accents. White numeral only at 40px+ (2.5:1).

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Handles and highlighted words ('@dentory'). Use at 20px+ on white (4:1); on sky-100 prefer blue-600.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Contact-bar text, phone and Facebook icons, links. 5.2:1 on white, 4.2:1 on sky-100 (large text only there).

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: Line icons in feature tiles and app-menu icons. 5.8:1 on white, 4.6:1 on lilac-100.

tokens.name: violet-400
tokens.usage: The violet step of the rainbow headline and pretty accents. 4.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Storefront neon violet — the clinic sign. Brand anchor for signage, social avatars and the logo mark. 5.2:1 with white.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep purple from the printed price list. Formal/print surfaces and serious text (prices, legal). 15.6:1 with white.

tokens.name: line-green
tokens.usage: LINE's own brand green — ONLY for 'เพิ่มเพื่อน' / LINE buttons. White text is 2.3:1 (LINE's spec); keep the label 24px+ bold beside the LINE logo.

tokens.name: title-coral
tokens.usage: Rainbow-headline stop 1 (coral). Gradient display titles only, never body text.

tokens.name: title-blue
tokens.usage: Rainbow-headline stop (blue). Gradient display titles only.

tokens.name: elastic-pink
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: pink. Only in the Braces Colours picker / swatch rows.

tokens.name: elastic-red
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: red. Swatches only.

tokens.name: elastic-orange
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: orange. Swatches only.

tokens.name: elastic-yellow
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: yellow. Swatches only.

tokens.name: elastic-green
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: green. Swatches only.

tokens.name: elastic-blue
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: blue. Swatches only.

tokens.name: elastic-purple
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: purple. Swatches only.

tokens.name: elastic-grey
tokens.usage: Braces elastic swatch: grey/smoke. Swatches only.

tokens.usage: Cards and speech bubbles — the poster's big soft corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, CTA, contact bar and badge. Dentory has no square corners.

tokens.name: shadow-soft

tokens.name: shadow-pink
tokens.usage: Under pink CTAs and the step-2 badge.
